verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own GitHub API repo points AI agents to an official Basecamp CLI under the basecamp GitHub org, so a first-party CLI exists and is positioned for agent use. The evidence is a single link-level mention with nothing on its commands, install steps, auth, or output formats. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's commands and coverage, install and auth details, machine-readable output for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
